raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "be a member of"
  role subject "14 members"
  role object "the chess club from Tulcea"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "be a junior"
  role subject "6"
  role object "members"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "be a FIDE master"
  role subject "2"
  role object "members"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s4 stated
  relation "be an amateur"
  role subject "the rest"
  role object "members"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s5 stated
  relation "be a junior"
  role subject "1"
  role object "FIDE masters"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  mode count
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "be an amateur"
      role subject ?x
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be a junior"
      role subject ?x
      polarity negated
    end
  end
